verdict.rationale: Supabase's own Branching feature creates separate environments that spin off from the main project and gives isolated preview environments per pull request, so a developer can test schema changes without affecting production. The evidence never shows that branches copy production data, are instant, or use copy-on-write storage, which is the heart of this story. Missing for 10: evidence of copy-on-write or instant branch creation, evidence that production data (not just schema) is copied into branches, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create an instant copy-on-write branch of my database — schema and data — to develop and test against production-shaped data

citations.quote: Supabase branches create separate environments that spin off from your main project. You can use these branching environments to create and test changes like new configurations, database schemas, or features without affecting your production setup.
Branching takes this further, adding isolated preview environments for each pull request.
